programs.name: Upper / Lower
programs.description: Two upper and two lower days. Each muscle trained twice a week — the standard hypertrophy split for 4 days.

programs.name: Full Body
programs.description: Three full-body sessions a week. Highest weekly frequency per muscle — the usual recommendation at 3 days a week.

programs.name: Push / Pull / Legs
programs.description: Push, Pull and Legs as a rolling cycle. Scales from 3 days a week (about 1.5x per muscle) up to 6 (2x).

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Pull your shoulder blades back and down and keep them pinned to the bench. Lower the bar to your mid-chest with elbows about 45 degrees from your torso, then press back up over your shoulder joint.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.cue: Slide the bench so the fixed bar path meets your mid-chest. Lower to a light touch without bouncing and press up. The guided path lets you push close to failure without a spotter.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Start with the dumbbells over your lower chest, elbows tucked to roughly 45 degrees. Lower until they are level with your chest for a stretch, then press up and slightly together.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.cue: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest. Press out without slamming into lockout, and let the handles come back until you feel a chest stretch with your shoulders staying down.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.cue: Fix a slight elbow bend and hold it for the whole set, driving with your upper arms rather than your hands. Squeeze for a beat in front of your chest, then control the stretch back.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.cue: Set the pulleys around shoulder height and take a staggered stance with a slight forward lean. Sweep your hands together in a wide arc with elbows softly bent, and resist the stretch on the way back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.cue: Lie back with the dumbbells above your chest and elbows locked at a slight bend. Open your arms in a wide arc to a comfortable stretch, then bring them together like closing a hug.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.cue: Set the bench to about 30 degrees. Bring the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest, then press up over your collarbones. Steeper angles turn this into a shoulder press.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.cue: Bench at about 30 degrees, bar lowered to just below the collarbone. Keep your shoulder blades pinned and drive the bar up and slightly back toward your face.

exercises.name: Incline Smith Press
exercises.cue: Position the bench so the fixed bar path touches your upper chest. Control the descent to a brief pause and press without bouncing off the stops.

exercises.name: Incline Machine Press
exercises.cue: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper-chest height. Press up and in, and stop just short of lockout to keep tension on the chest.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Sit upright against the back pad, dumbbells at ear height with palms forward. Press up until your arms are nearly straight without shrugging, then lower to a full stretch at the ears.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Set the seat so the handles start level with your shoulders. Press straight up, stop just short of lockout, and lower under control to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Start with the bar on your front delts, elbows just ahead of the bar. Brace your abs and glutes, press up and slightly back, and finish with the bar stacked over your mid-foot. Avoid leaning back excessively.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.cue: Keep your chest flat on the pad the whole set. Pull the handles to your lower ribs by driving your elbows back and down, squeeze the shoulder blades, then let them spread fully at the front. A dumbbell on an incline bench works the same way.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Row
exercises.cue: Sit tall with a slight forward lean to start, then pull the handle to your belly button while keeping your torso still. Let your arms extend and shoulders reach forward at the front for a full stretch.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.cue: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back and let the bar hang. Pull it to your lower ribs keeping your elbows over the bar, then lower under control. Hold the torso angle fixed the whole set.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.cue: Brace a hand and knee on the bench with a flat back. Row the dumbbell to your hip in a slight arc leading with the elbow, and let it hang for a shoulder stretch at the bottom. Do not twist your torso to lift it.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Grip a bit wider than your shoulders with your thighs pinned under the pad. Pull the bar to your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back, then let it rise until your lats are fully stretched. Avoid leaning back far.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Hang from a slightly wider than shoulder grip with your shoulders pulled down to start. Drive your elbows to your ribs until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way to straight arms. Add weight with a belt once you pass the top of the rep range.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Kneel or stand on the pad and pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar, then lower slowly to full extension. The number is how much help the machine gives, so aim to lower it over time.

exercises.name: Machine Pulldown
exercises.cue: Chest up, elbows driving down toward your back pockets. Get a full stretch overhead each rep without letting your shoulders shrug up to your ears.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Cable on the lowest pin, running across your body behind you. Lead with the elbow and raise your arm out to shoulder height with a soft elbow bend, then lower slowly. Keep your traps relaxed and do not shrug.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Slight forward lean, dumbbells just in front of your thighs. Raise out to the sides to shoulder height leading with your elbows, pause, then lower under control. No swinging or shrugging.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Set the pads against your outer upper arms, not your forearms. Push out to shoulder height and control the descent. Keep your torso still against the seat.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Machine or Cable)
exercises.cue: Chest on the pad, or cables crossed in front of you. Open your arms straight out to the sides with a fixed slight elbow bend, leading with your pinkies, and squeeze the rear delts only lightly at the back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
exercises.cue: Hinge over to about 45 degrees with your arms hanging and a soft elbow bend. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your torso, then lower slowly. Do not jerk with your lower back.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.cue: Rope at face height. Pull toward your forehead, splitting the rope so your hands finish beside your ears and your elbows stay high. Squeeze for a beat, then extend fully.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned to your sides with a slight forward lean. Push down until your arms are straight and squeeze, then let the weight pull your hands back to about collarbone height. Only your forearms move.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.cue: Face away from a high pulley with the rope overhead and your elbows beside your head. Extend until your arms are straight, keeping your elbows from flaring wide, then allow a deep stretch behind your head.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
exercises.cue: Lying on a bench, dumbbells above your forehead with elbows pointing at the ceiling. Bend at the elbow to lower the weights beside your ears, then extend without letting your elbows drift toward your hips.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.cue: Hold one dumbbell with both hands behind your head, elbows pointing forward and tucked in. Extend overhead to straight arms, then lower slowly to a full stretch. Keep your ribs down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.cue: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides. Curl without swinging, turning your pinky slightly up at the top, then lower all the way to straight arms. Curl both together or alternate.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.cue: Grip the inner angles of the bar with your elbows tight to your sides. Curl up without letting your elbows swing forward, squeeze, then lower under control to full extension.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.cue: Low pulley with a straight or EZ attachment, elbows pinned at your sides. Curl up, keep tension by not resting at the bottom, and control the negative fully.

exercises.name: Machine Curl
exercises.cue: Chest against the pad with your upper arms flat on it. Curl through a full range and resist on the way back down until your arms are straight. Do not lift your elbows off the pad.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.cue: Bar on your upper traps, feet about shoulder width with toes slightly out. Brace, sit down between your hips with your knees tracking over your toes, and drive up through mid-foot. Go to at least parallel.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.cue: Shoulders and back flat against the pad, feet in the middle of the platform. Lower until your thighs pass parallel with your knees tracking over your toes, then press up without locking your knees hard.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder width on the middle of the platform, lower back flat against the seat. Lower until your knees reach about 90 degrees, then press without locking out or letting your hips curl off the pad.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.cue: Set your feet slightly ahead of the bar so the fixed path stays balanced. Squat to at least parallel and drive back up. The rails let you push a hard set without a spotter.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with your elbows down. Squat between your knees keeping your chest tall until your elbows brush the inside of your knees, then stand.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.cue: Hold a support for balance, rise onto the balls of your feet, and lean back as your knees travel forward, lowering until you feel a deep quad stretch. Reverse by squeezing the quads. Hold a plate to your chest for added load.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Press
exercises.cue: One foot centered on the platform, hips square. Lower to a deep but pain-free knee bend and press back without locking out. Match the reps on both legs.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Start standing with the bar against your thighs and knees softly bent. Push your hips straight back, sliding the bar down your legs until you feel a strong hamstring stretch near mid-shin, then drive your hips forward. Keep your back flat and the bar close.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent. Hinge at the hips letting the weights track down your legs to a hamstring stretch, then stand tall by squeezing your glutes. Back stays flat throughout.

exercises.name: 45-Degree Back Extension
exercises.cue: Set the pads just below your hip bones so you can bend freely at the waist. Round down under control, then extend until your body is a straight line and no further. Hug a plate to your chest for load.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell or Machine)
exercises.cue: Upper back on the bench, bar over your hips with a pad. Drive through your heels until your torso is parallel to the floor and your shins are vertical, squeeze the glutes hard, then lower. Keep your chin tucked and ribs down.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
exercises.cue: Lie flat on the floor with the bar over your hips and feet close to your glutes. Push through your heels to lift your hips to full extension, squeeze, then lower just short of the floor. Shorter range than a hip thrust but quick to set up.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.cue: Face away from a low pulley with the rope between your legs. Hinge your hips back with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch, then snap your hips forward to standing and squeeze your glutes. Do not turn it into a squat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.cue: Rear foot on a bench, front foot far enough forward that your knee stays over your mid-foot at the bottom. Lower straight down until your rear knee nearly touches, then drive up through the front heel. A slight forward lean shifts load to the glutes.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.cue: Dumbbells at your sides. Step forward into a lunge until both knees are about 90 degrees, then push off the front foot to bring the back leg through into the next step. Keep your torso tall.

exercises.name: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.cue: Front foot on a low plate or step, rear foot planted behind. Drop straight down into a deep front-leg bend, then press back up. The elevation adds range for the quad without needing a bench behind you.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.cue: Pad just above your heels, thigh pad locked down snug. Curl your heels under the seat as far as you can and squeeze, then let the weight back slowly to straight legs. Keep your hips down.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.cue: Hips flat on the pad, roller on your lower calves. Curl to full contraction without your hips rising off the bench, then lower under control to straight legs.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.cue: Anchor your ankles with your body straight from knees to head. Lower yourself face-first as slowly as you can control, catch with your hands, then pull yourself back with the hamstrings. Very hard; shorten the range as needed.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Back against the seat, pad on your lower shins, knees lined up with the machine's pivot. Extend to straight legs and pause, then lower under control without letting the stack slam.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Balls of your feet on the platform, knees straight but not locked. Drop your heels for a full stretch, then push up as high as you can and pause at the top. A slow tempo beats bouncing.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Pad on your lower thighs, balls of your feet on the platform. The bent knee targets the soleus, so use a full stretch at the bottom and a hard squeeze with a brief pause at the top.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Feet low on the platform so only the balls of your feet are on it, legs nearly straight with the safeties on. Push the platform away by extending your ankles, then lower to a deep stretch. Never unlock and re-lock your knees under load.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.cue: Kneel facing the stack with the rope beside your head and your hips fixed. Crunch by rounding your spine and bringing your elbows toward your thighs, then return under control. The movement is your back rounding, not your hips folding.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.cue: Hang from a bar with active shoulders. Curl your knees toward your chest by rounding your pelvis, not just swinging your thighs, then lower slowly. Kill any swing before each rep. Squeeze a dumbbell between your feet for load.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine
exercises.cue: Grip the handles and set the pad on your chest. Crunch by flexing your spine against the resistance, pause at the bottom, then resist on the way back up. Move through your trunk, not your hips.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
exercises.cue: Ankles hooked on a decline bench. Curl your shoulders toward your hips by rounding your upper back while keeping your lower back down, then lower under control. Hold a plate on your chest to add weight.
